title: Book 3 — Thalia, Chapter 147
paragraphs: Then Otanes the Persian commander, seeing the Persians had suffered greatly, deliberately forgot the orders Darius had given him when he sent him out—not to kill any of the Samians nor to sell any into slavery, but to restore the island to Syloson free from all suffering. These orders, I say, he deliberately forgot, and gave the word to his army to slaughter everyone they caught, man or boy alike. So while some of the army were besieging the fortress, others were killing everyone who came their way, in sanctuary or out of sanctuary alike.
